description: The OKF knowledge harvester: judges one source instance's captured notes and session transcript by the OKF promotion doctrine, opens the labelled harvest PR with its provenance block, and retires once every destination is durably delivered (the maintainer reviews the PR without it).

harvester-max-age.description: How long a harvester whose delivery has not finished keeps its home (a duration like 7d, 48h or 90m, or seconds). At max-age it tells its operator and retires; the run's custody stays for recovery, and it never closes a PR.
